summary:
Complete project structure done. All files written and improved:

STACK: FastAPI + Groq LLM + PostgreSQL/pgvector + Telegram Bot + APScheduler

FILES COMPLETE:
- app/main.py — lifespan-based startup, CORS, webhook setup
- app/config.py — pydantic-settings
- app/database.py — SQLAlchemy async, User/Conversation/Alert/Document models
- app/ai/agent.py — Groq tool-calling agent (12 tools)
- app/ai/memory.py — pgvector semantic search memory
- app/ai/prompts.py — system prompt, onboarding prompts, morning brief prompt
- app/ai/tools.py — 12 tool definitions (stock, news, SEC, search, alerts, Gmail, Calendar, docs)
- app/bot/telegram_handler.py — text/voice/document/photo handler, typing indicator, message chunking
- app/bot/message_router.py — 5-step onboarding state machine + AI routing
- app/bot/voice_handler.py — Groq Whisper transcription
- app/services/finnhub_service.py — live quotes, company news, earnings calendar
- app/services/yahoo_finance.py — fundamentals, market overview, price history
- app/services/sec_edgar.py — EDGAR filings search + company facts
- app/services/web_search.py — Tavily primary, DuckDuckGo fallback
- app/services/document_service.py — PDF/DOCX extract, summarize, Q&A
- app/services/voice_service.py — Groq Whisper + Telegram file download
- app/services/google_service.py — Gmail search, Calendar events, OAuth
- app/scheduler/jobs.py — morning brief (every 30min check) + alert monitor (every 5min)
- app/scheduler/alerts.py — price_above/below/pct_change alert firing
- app/api/routes.py — /webhook, /health, /me
- app/api/auth.py — Google OAuth start + callback with success/error HTML
- app/models/user_repo.py — User CRUD, watchlist, alert operations
- Dockerfile — multi-stage, non-root user
- docker-compose.yml — pgvector/pg16 + api service
- setup.sh — quick local setup script
- All __init__.py files added
next_steps:
1. Test the bot locally: cp .env.example .env → fill keys → uvicorn app.main:app --reload
2. Use ngrok for webhook: ngrok http 8000
3. Optional: Add alembic migrations for DB schema versioning
4. Optional: Add /connect command handling in message_router for Google OAuth link
5. Record demo video showing: onboarding → stock query → PDF upload → alert → morning brief
